title: Rabbi Chiyya bar Titas
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Terumot 8:3 the Rabbis of Caesarea report his qualification concerning Rabbi Yitzchak bar Nachman’s statement in Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s name that the sharp, the bitter and the sweet are not subject to the prohibition of uncovered liquids. On this Rabbi Chiyya bar Titas said: “As in the case where one part of ground spices is mixed into three [parts in all].”

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital Terumot 8:3 gives Yitzchak bar Nachman’s rule separately and then cites the Rabbis of Caesarea in Chiyya bar Titas’s name for its qualification. Penei Moshe’s Piotrków digital commentary explains one part ground spices in two parts wine, three parts altogether. This supports a mixture of ground ingredients, not the act of grinding “one into three.”
